features: 16X optical zoom, 8X digital zoom; zoom speed 1.9/3.6/6.0 sec
Auto Focus, high-resolution integrated LowLight color camera
360° continuous pan rotation; unobstructed +2° to -92° tilt
0.1-150°/sec pan, Auto Flip 180° at bottom of tilt travel
250°/sec pan preset speed, 200°/sec tilt preset speed
proportional pan/tilt (decreases speed in proportion to zoom depth)
on-screen compass, tilt and zoom display; multilanguage menus (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German)
freeze frame between presets; programmable window blanking
digital position and zoom control and feedback via D Protocol (Coaxitron/RS-422)
environmental in-ceiling and pendant models meet NEMA Type 4X, IP66
electronic shutter 1/60-1/100,000 sec; S/N ratio 48 dB

frigate.notes: Analog composite (1 Vp-p, 75 ohm) PTZ dome — not a direct IP/RTSP source; ingest via an encoder or DVR, and control pan/tilt/zoom over Coaxitron/RS-422.

home_assistant.notes: Analog PTZ; view through a compatible encoder/DVR.

blue_iris.notes: Connect via a composite-video capture card or encoder/DVR.
